note: Stand-ins for Shoelace's docs images walk.gif and tie.webp, which its animated image test requests. Written for Velcro, with no third-party material and no copied Shoelace file: a 96x72 three-frame GIF of a block sliding across and a 96x72 three-frame lossless animated WebP of a block dropping, each under 1 KB. They are generated by tests/upstream/make-docs-images.mjs (run it with --check to compare). Binary files are not committed in this repository, so the bytes are stored as base64 text, served by the upstream runner (tests/upstream/docs-images.mjs) at /docs/assets/images/<name> with the content type of the file's extension, and carried by the docs examples as data: URLs. tests/upstream/docs-images.test.mjs and tests/product/animated-image.spec.mjs check the sizes, frames and that the examples carry the same bytes.
